fiction: Ancient ruined ledger library, elderly archivist, currency-like stained glass, collapsed roof, ledger book, embossed nameplate and luminous seal are symbolic art. The Realcoin issuance occurred in 2014, not in an ancient library; no actual premises, founder portrait, magical money creation or documented reserve holdings are represented. The tiny paper airplane is an intentional collection callback to 007, not a historical 2014 artifact.
